auth.tagline: Intambwe nto uyu munsi, u Rwanda rutoshye ejo.
auth.googleFailed: Kwinjira na Google ntibikunze ubu. Koresha imeyili yawe.
auth.terms: Ukomeje, wemeye gukoresha EcoStep mu kinyabupfura. Imeyili yawe ntigaragazwa abandi banyamuryango.
auth.checkEmailBody: Twohereje ubutumwa bwo kwemeza kuri {}. Andika kode, cyangwa ukande ku murongo uri muri imeyili hanyuma winjire.
auth.resetIntro: Andika imeyili ya konti yawe. Turakoherereza kode yo gushyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga rishya.
auth.resetCodeSent: Twohereje kode kuri {}. Yandike hamwe n'ijambo ry'ibanga rishya.

home.stepsSubtitle: Soma, wige, hanyuma ukore — iminota mike ku munsi.
home.allDone: Byose byarangiye uyu munsi. Tuzongera ejo!
home.step2Hint: Ibibazo 5 ku nkuru wasomye · amanota 5 kuri buri kimwe
home.step3Hint: Fata ifoto, usangize inkuru yawe · +{} amanota
home.lockedAfterRead: Kizafunguka umaze gusoma inkuru y'uyu munsi
home.scanBody: Erekeza kamera ku myanda iyo ari yo yose, AI ya EcoStep irakubwira uko wayicunga.
home.streakNone: Rangiza igikorwa cy'uyu munsi utangire uruhererekane!

news.subtitle: Inkuru z'ikirere n'ibidukikije ziturutse mu bitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda.
news.emptyBody: Inkuru nshya ziza buri saha. Kurura hasi uvugurure.
news.summaryOnly: {} itanga incamake gusa. Fungura inkuru yose umenye byose.
news.keepReading: Komeza usome — ibibazo bifunguka urangije inkuru.

quiz.title: Ibibazo by'umunsi
quiz.preparingBody: AI ya EcoStep irandika ibibazo ku nkuru wasomye. Bifata amasegonda make.
quiz.earned: Wabonye amanota {}. Intambwe ikurikira ni igikorwa cy'uyu munsi.
quiz.alreadyDone: Wamaze gusubiza ibibazo by'uyu munsi. Garuka ejo ubone ibindi.

mission.title: Igikorwa cy'ikirere
mission.addPhotoScan: Fotora icyo kintu — AI irakubwira niba kibora.
mission.storyHint: Wakoze iki, kandi wumvise umeze ute?
mission.privacy: Ifoto y'igikorwa cyawe ni ibanga — ni wowe wenyine uyibona.
mission.doneBody: Wakoze intambwe y'uyu munsi. Igikorwa gishya kiraza ejo.
mission.lockedRead: Soma inkuru y'uyu munsi kandi usubize ibibazo kugira ngo gifunguke.
mission.lockedQuiz: Subiza ibibazo by'uyu munsi kugira ngo igikorwa gifunguke.
mission.celebrateBody: Igikorwa cyawe cyabitswe mu rugendo rwawe.

scan.title: Suzuma
scan.heroBody: Fotora ikintu kimwe. AI ya EcoStep irakimenya ikanagusobanurira uko wakijugunya neza mu Rwanda.
scan.bioExamples: Ibisigazwa by'ibiryo, ibishishwa, amababi, impapuro, ibiti
scan.nonBioExamples: Pulasitiki, ibirahure, ibyuma, batiri, ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga
scan.bioExplainer: Ibi birabora ubwabyo. Bishobora kuvamo ifumbire aho kujugunywa.
scan.nonBioExplainer: Ibi ntibibora. Bibike ukwabyo kugira ngo byongere gukoreshwa cyangwa bitunganywe — ntuzigere ubitwika.
scan.uncertainExplainer: AI ntiyabashije kumenya imyanda igaragara neza. Ongera ufotore ikintu kimwe hafi kandi ahari urumuri.
scan.analysingBody: AI ya EcoStep irareba ifoto yawe
scan.disclaimer: Ibi ni ikigereranyo cya AI — kurikiza amabwiriza y'akarere kawe ku myanda.
scan.noneBody: Suzuma ikintu cya mbere ukibone hano.
scan.tip1: Inama: igishishwa cy'umuneke kibora mu byumweru bike.
scan.tip2: Inama: icupa rya pulasitiki rishobora kumara imyaka irenga 450.
scan.tip3: Inama: u Rwanda rwaciye amasashe mu 2008.
scan.tip4: Inama: ntugatwike pulasitiki — umwotsi wayo ni uburozi.

camera.none: Nta kamera iri kuri iyi telefoni.
camera.permissionBody: EcoStep ikeneye kamera kugira ngo imenye imyanda kandi ibike ibikorwa byawe.

community.pointsInfo: Abanyamuryango baha ifoto yawe inyenyeri. Ubona inota 1 kuri buri wese ugutoye.
community.emptyBody: Ba uwa mbere usangiza umuryango igikorwa kirengera ibidukikije.
community.alreadyRated: Wamaze gutanga amanota kuri iyi foto.

history.title: Urugendo rwanjye
history.emptyBody: Ibikorwa warangije bizagaragara hano hamwe n'amafoto n'inkuru zawe.

profile.about: EcoStep · Ibikorwa birengera ikirere mu Rwanda. Amakuru ava kuri Taarifa, Green Africa, KT Press, Rebero, Umuseke na Izuba.

admin.intro: Shimira umunyamuryango ku gikorwa yakoreye hanze ya porogaramu. Buri gihembo kirabikwa.
